title: IonQ Positioned as a Market Shaper in Inaugural Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant for Quantum Computing – Established Vendors
summary: IonQ has been named a Market Shaper in the inaugural Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™ for Quantum Computing. Access the complimentary Gartner report today.
body_markdown:
*Complimentary access to the Gartner report is available from IonQ*


**COLLEGE PARK, Md. — Nov. 10, 2026 —** IonQ (NYSE: IONQ), the world's leading full-stack quantum platform and foundry, today announced it has been positioned as a Market Shaper in the inaugural Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™ for Quantum Computing. IonQ appears in the Market Shapers quadrant of the graphic below.


In the report, Gartner states: “Market Shapers have proven their ability to reliably deliver and support cutting-edge systems in commercial environments, making them generally less risky bets for technology buyers seeking transformation.” Gartner also states: “These vendors are low-risk, high-impact leaders of the emerging quantum market.”


‍


*This graphic was published by Gartner, Inc. as part of a larger research document and should be evaluated in the context of the entire document. The Gartner document is available upon request from IonQ, Inc.*


*Source: Gartner, Emerging Market Quadrant for Quantum Computing, Gaurav Gupta, Matthew Brisse, Chirag Dekate, November 2026.*


“We’re honored by this recognition from Gartner. We feel this is a significant validation of what our team has built,” said Niccolo de Masi, Chairman and CEO of IonQ. “It reflects years of work on our full-stack quantum platform that customers are using today as well as our consistent execution toward our fault tolerant roadmap. Quantum has now moved out of the lab with accelerating real world use cases and commercial deployment. We believe IonQ is building the quantum ecosystem and setting the industry standard.”


IonQ has announced several milestones this fall. In October, the company advanced to[Stage C of DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking Initiative](https://ionq.com/news/ionq-advances-to-final-stage-of-darpas-quantum-benchmarking-initiative) , under an agreement with a potential value of up to $300 million. It also received[$7.5 million in follow-on funding from the Air Force Research Laboratory](https://ionq.com/news/ionq-awarded-7-5-million-follow-on-funding-from-afrl-to-advance-full-stack-quantum-networking) to expand a quantum network in Rome, New York. In September, IonQ demonstrated a[real-time quantum error decoder](https://ionq.com/news/ionq-demonstrates-industrys-first-end-to-end-real-time-quantum-error-decoder) that runs on a single standard CPU. Also in September, the company announced Superion 256 systems headed to[Florida International University](https://ionq.com/news/ionqs-superion-256-platform-selected-by-florida-international-university-for-flagship-deployment) ,[SDT in South Korea](https://ionq.com/news/ionq-and-sdt-announce-the-first-strategic-partnership-to-bring-both-advanced-quantum-computing-and-quantum-networking-to-the-asia-pacific-region) , and[NVIDIA’s Accelerated Quantum Research Center](https://ionq.com/news/ionq-to-advance-quantum-supercomputing-by-bringing-first-qpu-to-nvidia-accelerated-quantum-research-center) .


Complimentary access to the report is available here:[https://www.ionq.com/gartner-quantum-computing-magic-quadrant.](https://www.ionq.com/gartner-quantum-computing-magic-quadrant)

**About IonQ**


[IonQ, Inc](https://ionq.com/) . \[NYSE: IONQ\] is the world’s leading quantum platform and foundry - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the Superion, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems. Earlier systems have helped customers and partners including[Amazon Web Services, AstraZeneca, and NVIDIA](https://www.ionq.com/news/ionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with) achieve a 20x performance increase over previous quantum solutions and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity,[setting a world record in quantum computing performance](https://ionq.com/news/ionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing) .


Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations across North America, Latin America, EMEA, and APAC. Our quantum computing services have been available through all major cloud providers since 2021, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. Learn more at[IonQ.com](http://ionq.com/) **.**
